SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', id::text, 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::jsonb, 'properties', properties ) ), '[]'::jsonb ) ) FROM gis_feature
WHERE geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{dto.minX}, #{dto.minY}, #{dto.maxX}, #{dto.maxY}, 4326) AND ST_Intersects( geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{dto.minX}, #{dto.minY}, #{dto.maxX}, #{dto.maxY}, 4326) )

SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE( jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', id::text, 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::jsonb, 'properties', properties ) ), '[]'::jsonb ) ) FROM gis_feature WHERE ( geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(170, #{dto.minY}, 180, #{dto.maxY}, 4326) AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(170, #{dto.minY}, 180, #{dto.maxY}, 4326)) ) OR ( geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, #{dto.minY}, -170, #{dto.maxY}, 4326) AND ST_Intersects(geom, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, #{dto.minY}, -170, #{dto.maxY}, 4326)) )
SELECT id, name, jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(geom)::jsonb, 'properties', properties ) AS geo_json, properties, created_at FROM gis_feature WHERE id = #{id}
